verdict.rationale: Exa's Websets API documents real-time HTTP callbacks that fire as items are added or enriched, and says results can arrive asynchronously through webhooks. That is a first-party outbound HTTP event subscription a programmatic consumer can receive. Coverage is thin and appears scoped to Websets rather than Search or Agent runs, and there is no independent confirmation that it works. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration/management endpoints, an event-type catalog, payload signing/verification and retry semantics, webhook coverage beyond Websets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
